body: Locked tripod 35mm view through a rainy late-night diner window. A young East Asian woman in an olive sweater reads in a warm booth. Freeze her face, eyes, hair, hands, sweater and booth in every frame. Animate only diagonal raindrops and cyan-and-amber neon reflections on the glass, returning to the starting rain pattern. No text.
